scope.candidate_slice_note: The 899 R02/R03 audit slice includes global 102-112 (11 preserved M32 Tiki records). They are analyzed read-only; 888 generated records occupy global 113-1000 plus 201-1000 excluding Sunny Cove and Tiki seed records.

assumptions.theoretical_T: sum(2^(target_level-3) * quantity) for normal objectives; VIP is separate; total_T includes enabled VIP for the 4T budget and stars denominator
assumptions.random_launch_mix: uniform independent launch levels 1,2,3 with L1-equivalent values 1,2,4; expected value 7/3 per launch
assumptions.expected_launches: ceil is not applied to the expectation; an additional integer ceiling is provided as a planning budget only. Random variance, merge geometry, strategy, retries, and player skill are excluded
assumptions.planning_time: 1.5-3.0 seconds per expected launch from M17DifficultyModel's 1.5-second provisional launch cadence multiplied by its 1x-2x planning multiplier; not observed human data, excludes aiming/settling/menu time, and is not a human fairness certification
assumptions.stars: production calculate_stars: normal objective completion required; 1-star permits <=4T launches, 2-star <=3T-1, 3-star <=2T-1; score and VIP completion do not change star calculation
assumptions.vip_intermediate_flag: same conservative M17 heuristic as R02: higher normal targets can create VIP-level intermediate pieces; flag means reserve-sensitive recipe, not forced VIP capture. Runtime M17VipOptionalityModel is the production authority

suspicion_thresholds.interpretation: review thresholds for workload/step diagnostics; never physical-impossibility thresholds

hypothetical_normal_duration_minutes.note: planning assumption only; excludes aiming, settling, retries, and observed human data
